title: 第25章 必须得到它第26章 远古铠甲
slug: 聚宝仙锅第1038章天龟肆虐
content_zh:
这个空间宽敞的密室，显然是开凿不久。
墙壁上还有一些开凿过的痕迹。
高级月亮石！
即使西凤商盟在敌对势力的打压下，已经不复当年之勇。
可是，俗话说得好，瘦死额骆驼比马大。
西凤商盟，还是有一定的实力。
闲话少叙。
福伯退出密室，李凡也不客气，开始逐一打开这个新建成的许家宝库的所有箱子。
“李供奉，这批宝物是刚刚运来，还没有整理！”
三小姐解释。
“无妨！”
李凡反倒是乐此不疲，他非常喜欢这种探宝的感觉，仿佛回到过去收破烂的光阴。
在一堆破烂中，发现有价值的物品，那种成就感，让人十分兴奋。
打开大概七八个箱子，却没有发现什么能入自己眼帘的宝物。
如今的李凡，眼界开阔，再不是一件下品飞剑都让其兴奋不已的修仙界菜鸟。
又打开一个箱子，李凡眼前一亮。
这个箱子里面，全部是码放整齐的符咒。
当然，大部分都是普通的低级符咒，中级符咒只有三张。
李凡也不客气，先把这三张中级符咒拿到手。
下面，再打开几个箱子，李凡又拿走一把上品法器飞剑。

只可惜，没有发现上好的防御性上品法器。
李凡只好退而求其次，拿走一面中品法器盾牌。
搜刮一遍，只有五件宝物，李凡看上眼。
“李供奉，知道你对一些废弃宝物感兴趣，故此，小女子找来一批这种类型的物品。”
三小姐当真是冰雪聪明，善解人意。
三个大箱子！
李凡立刻兴趣十足。
“咦？”
不消片刻，李凡发现一个大盒子，里面是各种阵旗，中轴，灵物配件。
不过，显然这些组成阵法的物品，全部损坏严重。
不过，李凡却是心中一怔。
既然大铁锅能够修复法器，那么阵法或许也能修复。
“李供奉，这是一套风火天绝阵，虽然损坏严重，但所有组成部分都齐全。
这套阵法，可了不得，可以困住炼气期大圆满的修士！”
三小姐一边解释。
李凡也不客气，这套阵法据为己有。
把剩下的两个大箱子打开，李凡又有发现。
content_en:
This spacious secret room had obviously been excavated not long ago.
There are still some traces of digging on the walls.
Premium moon stone!
Even under the pressure of hostile forces, the Xifeng Merchant Alliance has lost its former courage.
However, as the saying goes, a skinny camel is bigger than a horse.
The Xifeng Merchant Alliance still has some strength.
Stop gossiping.
Uncle Fu exited the secret room, and Li Fan was not polite and began to open all the boxes in the newly built Xu family treasure house one by one.
"Li Gongfeng, this batch of treasures has just arrived and has not been sorted out yet!"
The third lady explained.
"It doesn't matter!"
On the contrary, Li Fan never tired of it. He liked this feeling of treasure hunting very much, as if he had gone back to the past to collect rags.
The sense of accomplishment of finding valuable items among a pile of junk is very exciting.
I opened about seven or eight boxes, but I didn't find any treasures that caught my eye.
Today, Li Fan has a broad vision and is no longer a rookie in the world of immortality who is excited by even a low-grade flying sword.
Opening another box, Li Fan's eyes lit up.
Inside this box are all neatly arranged talismans.
Of course, most of them are ordinary low-level spells, and there are only three intermediate-level spells.
Li Fan was not polite and got these three intermediate spells first.
Below, Li Fan opened a few more boxes and took out a high-grade magic weapon, the Flying Sword.
It's a pity that no good defensive high-grade magic weapon has been found.
Li Fan had no choice but to do the next best thing and take away a medium-grade magic weapon shield.
After searching, there were only five treasures, and Li Fan took his fancy.
"Li Gongfeng, I know that you are interested in some abandoned treasures, so the little girl found a batch of this type of items."
The third young lady is really smart and considerate.
Three big boxes!
Li Fan was immediately interested.
"Huh?"
After a while, Li Fan found a big box, which contained various array flags, central shafts, and spiritual accessories.
However, it was obvious that all the items that made up the formation were seriously damaged.
However, Li Fan was startled.
Since the big iron cauldron can repair the magic weapon, then the formation may also be able to repair it.
"Li Gongfeng, this is a set of wind, fire and heaven formation. Although it is seriously damaged, all components are complete.
This formation is amazing, it can trap monks who are in the Great Perfection stage of Qi refining! "
The third lady explained.
Li Fan was not polite and took this formation as his own.
After opening the remaining two large boxes, Li Fan made another discovery.
